packageRules.description: The gomod manager ignores indirect dependencies by default, so transitive modules never get security bumps (this is why golang.org/x/crypto sat three advisories behind).

Our own release image's tag is already fully immutable per release — release.yml builds and pushes it exactly once, right after release-please cuts the version. Digest-pinning it on top races release-please's version bump: the bump only rewrites the version text (the x-release-please-version marker doesn't know the new digest yet), so values.yaml briefly points at a plausible-looking but stale digest until Renovate's next scan catches up and re-pins. That gap deployed a stale image under a new version label once already — don't pin this one.
